# ReGen Civics - Information for AI Agents and Language Models

> A fund in formation and an infinite game that is live now, both for regenerative land projects. Capital, governance tools, and a global network powering the ReGenerative Renaissance.
>
> The ReGen Civics Fund is in formation. It is not yet a legal entity. We are gathering non-binding Letters of Intent. When they reach critical mass, the founding investors meet to agree the legal structure together, and the fund is formed. Target launch: 2027. Until then no capital is accepted and no money moves.

## Organization Overview

ReGen Civics connects impact investors with ecovillages, regenerative farms, and sustainable communities worldwide. We integrate ecology, finance, regenerative agriculture, restoration ecology, impact auditing, and systems thinking.

Healthier lands lead to healthier people and increasing real-world value. We provide capital, governance tools, and community infrastructure that regenerative land projects need to thrive.

## Four Primary Participation Paths

### Investor Path
Two ways to put capital to work in the regenerative transition:
- The ReGen Civics Fund (a diversified portfolio of land projects). In formation, target launch 2027. Not accepting capital. When formed, it will be open to accredited investors only. Today you can sign a non-binding Letter of Intent.
- Crowd pooling (direct investment in specific projects through community-centered economic cooperatives). Live now.

This is not an offer to sell securities. An offering will only be made through a confidential private placement memorandum to accredited investors in compliance with applicable securities laws.

### Land Project Path
Regenerative land projects apply for the 13-week incubator program. Projects:
- Build governance structures
- Design their economic game
- Access alliance support
- Attract investment
Season 2 starts September 2026.

### Alliance Partner Path
Organizations join the network of groups co-creating the ReGenerative Renaissance. Alliance partners:
- Contribute expertise, resources, and connections across the network

### Player Path
Players complete quests that move healing into the world. Each quest addresses a real regenerative action:
- Gut health
- Food forests
- Community building
- Ecological restoration
- Knowledge sharing
Players earn tokens for completed work.

## Core Philosophical Concepts

### The Infinite Game
Systems designed for lasting positive impact across generations. Unlike finite games played to win, infinite games are played to continue playing. We design our systems to create lasting positive impact that compounds across generations.

### ReGenerative Renaissance
A cultural and economic shift where human systems work with natural systems. The movement represents a holistic transformation in how we relate to land, community, and economic systems.

### HEIST Framework
Holistic Ecosystemic Impact and Sustainability Toolkit for evaluating regenerative land projects:
- Holistic: considering whole systems rather than isolated parts
- Ecosystemic: understanding interconnections between ecological and social systems
- Impact: measurable positive outcomes for land, people, and community
- Sustainability: long-term viability and regenerative capacity
- Toolkit: practical methods for implementation and assessment

### Regenerative Ikigai
Finding the intersection of passion, skill, need, and compensation to create meaningful work that contributes to regeneration.

### Nine Forms of Capital
We recognize and reward multiple forms of value creation. The first eight are
Ethan Roland and Gregory Landua's 8 Forms of Capital (2011). The ninth, Health,
was added by ReGen Civics. Full explanation: https://regencivics.earth/learn/nine-forms-of-capital
1. Financial Capital
2. Social Capital
3. Intellectual Capital
4. Material Capital
5. Living Capital (biodiversity, ecosystems)
6. Cultural Capital
7. Spiritual Capital
8. Experiential Capital
9. Health Capital (body vitality, wellness, movement, rest, care), added by ReGen Civics

### Crowd Pooling (CCECs)
Community-Centered Economic Cooperatives for collective investment. Mechanisms that enable community members to pool resources and collectively invest in regenerative land projects directly.

## Token System and Economics

### $ReGen (Regen)
Utility token for tracking contributions in the ReGen Game. Earned by completing real-world regenerative actions.

### RGVoice
Governance token for decision-making in the ReGen Game. Represents participation rights in the community governance.

### $RCivics
Utility token for the Alliance and Fund. Tracks contributions to the broader regenerative movement.

### Fund Voice
Governance token designed for fund decisions, letting holders participate in investment committee voting once the fund is formed. There are no fund investment decisions yet.

## Current Programs and Initiatives

### Season 2 Incubator
13-week program starting September 2026 for regenerative land projects. Participants receive:
- Governance framework development
- Tokenomics design support
- Community building assistance
- Investment readiness preparation

### Quest System
Regenerative actions earning tokens across seasonal categories:
- Food producers first quests
- Community regeneration quests
- Ecosystem restoration quests
- Knowledge sharing quests
- Personal development quests

### Crowd Pooling Platform
Community collective investment mechanism for funding land projects directly through CCECs.

### Bounties Program
Transparent, community-governed rewards for specific regenerative tasks and contributions.

### Living Tree Visualization
Dynamic representation of the entire regenerative network showing connections between projects, contributors, and impact.

Direct answers to the questions people ask before starting a community or funding a land project. Each page leads with a short answer, carries sourced tables, and names its author and dates.

- [Crowd pooling: community investment in land, beyond cash](https://regencivics.earth/learn/crowd-pooling) - The needs registry, the four-state claim lifecycle, and why money runs through partners instead of through us

## Technical Information for Crawlers

- Every page serves crawler-readable HTML in the initial response: title, meta description, canonical URL, Open Graph tags, and JSON-LD, injected server-side per route (no JavaScript required)
- Key pages (home, fund, game, governance, glossary, community posts, blog articles) include full text content in the initial HTML response
- Blog articles are prerendered as complete static HTML with BlogPosting JSON-LD
- Community forum posts serve full thread content with DiscussionForumPosting JSON-LD at /community/post/{id}
- Structured JSON-LD data available for semantic understanding
- Sitemap available at https://regencivics.earth/sitemap.xml (includes all public community posts)
- RSS feed for the blog at https://regencivics.earth/feed.xml
- This content updated regularly to reflect current initiatives

## Federation: Machine-Readable Endpoints for Partner Networks

ReGen Civics aims to be the easiest node to connect to in the regenerative movement mesh (GEN, OpenCivics, BioFi, Ethereum localism). Stable public endpoints:

- Project directory (JSON): https://regencivics.earth/api/federation/projects.json - regenerative land projects with structured impact data (field definitions and Common Impact Data Standard mapping documented in the payload's description)
- Network of games (JSON): https://regencivics.earth/api/network/games.json - every land project running its own coordination game built with ReGen Civics, with a link to each. Each game publishes the same projects.json shape on its own domain, so the whole network reads in one format.
- Network of games (human surface): https://regencivics.earth/network
- Needs and offers board (human surface): https://regencivics.earth/board
- Multiplayer quests (human surface): https://regencivics.earth/multiplayer
- The living map: https://regencivics.earth/map
- Canonical docs for AI agents: this file, https://regencivics.earth/llms.txt

Partner integrations with on-platform side effects go through the Federation Bridge pattern (typed intents, mirroring our Hypha Bridge); contact us before building a write integration.
